closed_findings.impact: Original startup exceptions escaped cleanup, retaining subprocess/pipe resources. Repeated failures could exhaust controller resources.
closed_findings.minimal_fix_already_present: Allocate the selector before spawn; initialize process to None; guard spawn/setup and existing cleanup.
closed_findings.proof: Inject DefaultSelector() ENFILE while substituting a newly owned benign Python sleeper for SSH. Original: one live child, three open pipes, fd delta +3. Corrected: zero spawned children and fd delta 0. Reviewer explicitly killed/reaped/closed original control.
closed_findings.remediation_reference: The concrete corrected code is preserved in snapshot/tests/crawl-jobs-v2-observer/context_transport.py:61-120; no reviewer source edits.

nonblocking_observations.impact: False-negative offline test result under restrictive umask; no permission bypass or production security weakening was demonstrated.
nonblocking_observations.minimal_fix:
root = Path(folder) / "code"
root.mkdir(mode=0o755)
root.chmod(0o755)  # exact simulated install mode, inside private TemporaryDirectory
nonblocking_observations.proof: The reviewer set umask 077 to keep retained outputs private. root.mkdir(mode=0o755) therefore made mode 0700; context_files.directory correctly rejected it. Full suite: 196 passes, 1 error (CONTEXT_DIRECTORY). The unchanged single test passed under umask 022.
nonblocking_observations.recommendation: Optional fixture hardening only. Do not relax the application file checks or globally weaken umask. The retained full-suite report remains FAIL and must not be advertised as a clean 197/197 run.

rationale: No unresolved exploitable security-boundary violation found within the documented root/operator trust model. COR-SSH-001 is independently reproduced on original source and verified fixed; static artifacts match original evidence exactly. One nonblocking umask-dependent test-fixture observation is retained transparently.

source.scope: Full increment diff; all new context_files/provision/ssh/transport modules; context_worker/contracts/runtime_context/Linux observations/runtime_admission/DockerBackend integration and relevant tests. Existing native artifacts statically inspected, not runtime admitted.

trust_boundaries: Root/operator is the trust root. Root-replaced source/interpreter/client or operator-supplied false anchors are not out-of-model authentication bypass findings.

Controller bundle is operator-owned 0700/0600; files are bounded, regular, single-link, no-follow, stable-identity reads. Per-exchange key/known-host copies are private and removed after tested refusals.

SSH host/client pins are supplied out of band. Numeric host validation, fixed argv/config, strict known-host checking, no agent/proxy/forwarding/control channel, constant remote marker, source HMAC/fresh challenge and preparation/daemon/lease bindings constrain the boundary.
The library functions are not capability boundaries against malicious code already running as the controller UID. Public API/fixture mutation is not an attacker foothold by itself.

Final path components are checked in code. Secure non-symlink ancestors, root-controlled runtime dependencies, account/home/startup environment and live effective sshd policy remain the documented operator admission obligations.
Public manifests/receipts carry no secret bytes or secret-file hashes and do not certify installation, runtime feasibility or execution authorization.
